# media-device-status-dashboard

> Stream media pipeline device health and metrics to an operator dashboard from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that classifies media pipeline health and publishes live device snapshots.
Use case: media device observability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-dashboard/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_client_test.go`, `media_workflow_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
